bibl.title: Punishing the Incompetent Physician: Some Neglected Cases.
bibl.seg: Vivian Nutton, Punishing the Incompetent Physician: Some Neglected Cases.
Nicola Reggiani (ed.), Greek Medical Papyri Text, Context, Hypertext = ArchPF. Beiheft 40 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 133-138.
bibl.note: Four incidents, three reported by Galen, the other described on a papyrus from Roman Egypt [P. Oxy. I, 40], neatly illustrate a range of actions that might be taken, as well as the limitations of the law.
